Bug fix for the desktop app.

## Fixed

- **A white box at the bottom of every page that wouldn't close.** The "Add a posting" form and the posting-history box were showing even when closed, most visibly at the bottom of Settings. They're now hidden until you open them, and Cancel / Close work normally.

## Download

| Platform | File | Install |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows 11** | `autoapply-0.2.1-windows.zip` | Extract the zip, open a terminal in the folder, and run `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1` |
| **Linux** (Arch, plus any distro) | `autoapply-0.2.1-linux.tar.gz` | `tar xzf autoapply-0.2.1-linux.tar.gz && cd autoapply-0.2.1-linux && ./install.sh` |

Installing over 0.2.0 keeps your profile, settings and job history.
